enrichment.summary: Configures standard inbound anti-spam settings to quarantine phishing and high-confidence spam, move spam and bulk emails to Junk Email, and enable zero-hour auto purge for enhanced email security.
enrichment.rationale: Helps organisations minimise the risk of phishing attacks, reduce exposure to spam, and maintain a cleaner email environment by applying Microsoft-recommended anti-spam settings.
enrichment.licensing: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Plan 1 (Microsoft 365 E5)
